text:
oncall-bot: :warning: Alert: Dedicated allocation failure spike in us-west-2 for reserved pools. Placement failures and 429s >= 5% for the last 6m. Notifying channel.

Maya R.: Customers (two enterprise tenants) reporting repeated failed allocations, high latency on create-job, and some 503s on inference endpoints. Escalating.

Kevin L.: Looking at placement service logs — lots of `INSUFFICIENT_GPU` responses from allocator. Autoscaler attempted scale but returned `quota_exceeded`.

Samir P.: Confirmed — autoscale call to control-plane returned 403 with `QuotaExceeded: GPUs per-region limit`. That would prevent new nodes.

Talia (Eng): Can we temporarily divert new Dedicated allocs to us-west-1 or us-east-1? Routing policy for Dedicated is region strict by default.

Kevin L.: Fallback route tried once but failed: runtime rejected with `model-variant-mismatch` because customer pinned a custom quantized variant not available in fallback region.

Nisha (Support): Customer A says they saw billing spikes after retries — their app retried allocations, got duplicate reservations, then partial refunds. Need repro steps to explain to billing.

Alex PM: We need quick mitigation plan for customer-facing comms and an internal action list.

Maya R.: Repro steps I ran:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/allocate -d '{"tenant_id":"T-123","pool":"reserved-usw2","instance_type":"gpu-16x"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'
2) Response: 429 TooManyRequests / 503 ServiceUnavailable or JSON `{\"error\":\"INSUFFICIENT_GPU\"}`

Kevin L.: Paste of allocator log around failures:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:12Z allocator[alloc-svc] ERROR allocation failed tenant=T-123 region=us-west-2 reason=INSUFFICIENT_GPU avail=0 requested=8
2026-03-17T14:02:13Z autoscaler[scale-agent] WARN scale-up blocked tenant=T-123 reason=QuotaExceeded region=us-west-2 current=120 limit=120
2026-03-17T14:03:01Z allocator[alloc-svc] INFO fallback_attempt tenant=T-123 target_region=us-west-1 result=variant_mismatch
```

Samir P.: Root cause appears to be twofold: regional capacity shortage + per-account GPU quota cap hit. Some noisy-tenant behavior earlier filled the reserve pool and eviction didn't free as expected due to runtime stuck jobs.

Talia (Eng): Quick mitigations we can do now: 1) bump internal reserve/burst for high-tier customers (manual override) 2) allow cross-region fallbacks for pinned variants by auto-selecting closest compatible variant (requires runtime flag) 3) short-term customer-level rate-limiting to prevent duplicate allocation retries. Which can we safely flip?

Kevin L.: I can flip manual burst for affected tenants now (will consume our shared emergency pool). Need PM approval.

Alex PM: Approve manual burst for these two customers for 2h to buy time. Coordinate with billing to note potential duplicate reservations and to suppress charges while we reconcile.

Nisha (Support): Messaging to customer draft: "We're seeing a transient GPU availability issue in us-west-2 affecting Dedicated allocations. We've opened a temporary burst for your workloads and are investigating root cause. You may see retries; we will reconcile any billing anomalies." Send after Kevin confirms change. :white_check_mark:

Maya R.: Additional repro: some allocations returned `auth: token expired` intermittently during retries which triggered a retry loop at client side. Suggest we add idempotency token guide in support KB to prevent duplicate charges.

Samir P.: Longer-term: need automated detection for noisy tenants (high sustained allocation churn) + auto-evict low-priority batch jobs to free GPUs. Also review quota headroom alarms.

Kevin L.: Manual burst applied to tenants T-123 and T-456 at 14:26 UTC. Monitoring allocations now.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Incident ticket INC-2026-042 created and linked to runbook https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042

Nisha (Support): Customer A confirmed reduced failures after 14:30. They still saw 1 leftover duplicate reservation; billing team flagged for manual crediting.

Alex PM: Next steps: engineering postmortem, quota alarm tuning, add idempotency guidance to KB, explore cross-region variant availability or automated variant fallback. Assign owners in ticket.

Maya R.: Filing repro logs and curl traces into the incident ticket. Will follow up with customer write-up.

Samir P.: Adding note to ticket: possible contributing factor—image-pull timeouts on new nodes causing autoscaler not to count them as ready. Need infra team to check node bootstrap logs.

Talia (Eng): I'll take bootstrap logs and follow up in ticket. Good catch.

Kevin L.: Current status: allocation failure rate in us-west-2 dropped from 5.2% -> 0.8% after manual burst. Keeping channel updated. :eyes:
